title: Arya and Bran
statementMd:
Bran and his older sister Arya are from the same house. Bran like candies so much, so Arya is going to give him some Candies.

At first, Arya and Bran have $0$ Candies. There are $*n*$ days, at the $*i*$-th day, Arya finds $*a*_{*i*}$ candies in a box, that is given by the Many-Faced God. Every day she can give Bran **at most** $8$ of her candies. If she don't give him the candies at the same day, they are saved for her and she can give them to him later.

Your task is to find the minimum number of days Arya needs to give Bran $*k*$ candies **before** the end of the $*n*$-th day. Formally, you need to output the minimum day index to the end of which $*k*$ candies will be given out (the days are indexed from 1 to $*n*$).

Print `-1` if she can't give him $*k*$ candies during $*n*$ given days.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10000$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

## Output

If it is impossible for Arya to give Bran $*k*$ candies within $*n*$ days, print `-1`.

Otherwise print a single integer — the minimum number of days Arya needs to give Bran $*k*$ candies before the end of the $*n*$-th day.

## Note

In the first sample, Arya can give Bran $3$ candies in $2$ days.

In the second sample, Arya can give Bran $17$ candies in $3$ days, because she can give him at most $8$ candies per day.

In the third sample, Arya can't give Bran $9$ candies, because she can give him at most $8$ candies per day and she must give him the candies within $1$ day.
statementZhMd:
布兰和他的姐姐艾莉亚来自同一个家族。布兰非常喜欢糖果，因此艾莉亚打算给他一些糖果。

起初，艾莉亚和布兰都拥有 $0$ 颗糖果。有 $*n*$ 天，在第 $*i*$ 天，艾莉亚会在一个由千面之神赐予的盒子里发现 $*a*_{*i*}$ 颗糖果。每天她最多可以给布兰 **8** 颗糖果。如果她当天不把糖果给他，这些糖果就会留给她，之后再给他。

你的任务是找出艾莉亚在第 $*n*$ 天结束前给布兰 $*k*$ 颗糖果所需的最少天数。形式化地说，你需要输出这样一个最小的天数编号：截至这一天结束时，已经给出了 $*k*$ 颗糖果（天数编号从 1 到 $*n*$）。

如果在给定的 $*n*$ 天内无法给布兰 $*k*$ 颗糖果，请输出 `-1`。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10000$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

如果艾莉亚无法在 $*n*$ 天内给布兰 $*k*$ 颗糖果，请输出 `-1`。

否则，输出一个整数——艾莉亚在第 $*n*$ 天结束前给布兰 $*k*$ 颗糖果所需的最少天数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，艾莉亚可以在 2 天内给布兰 3 颗糖果。

在第二个样例中，艾莉亚可以在 3 天内给布兰 17 颗糖果，因为她每天最多只能给他 8 颗糖果。

在第三个样例中，艾莉亚无法给布兰 9 颗糖果，因为她每天最多只能给他 8 颗糖果，而她必须在 1 天内给完糖果。
